messages:
maria: quick heads-up — canary for model-azul-quant v2 on eu-west is showing tokenization drift on long prompts (>1024). requesting a temporary runtime pin to 2.14.1 for canaries while we triage. deploybot, can you apply a soft-pin for 1h? :rotating_light:

deploybot: action=pin runtime=2.14.1 scope=eu-west duration=1h requested_by=maria status=pending

deploybot: action=pin runtime=2.14.1 scope=eu-west duration=1h requested_by=maria status=success expires_at=3851238167

raj: can you paste the failing snippet? is this a tokenization preprocessor or model mismatch?

maria: paste: "input_tokens: [CLS] ... unexpected 0xEF sequence at pos 1029". Appears only when we hit multi-byte boundary after 1024. Not seen in self-hosted tests. Triggered in canary dataset (long-docs corpus).

qa-bot: regression-check: long-docs-suite — 3/120 failed, severity=medium, sample-ids=[ld-0012, ld-0033, ld-0099]

raj: hmm, could be runtime's tokenizer lib bump in 2.15 that slipped into canary images. Pin to 2.14.1 makes sense. Any telemetry on latency impact?

maria: negligible. This is safety-first; we need deterministic outputs for customers. Proposal: extend pin to 3h while Dmitri and I run a bisect and try a shim that normalizes utf-8 chunks across the tokenizer boundary.

deploybot: note: pin applied is a soft-pin (deploybot soft-pin semantics: routes prefer pinned runtime, fallbacks allowed if capacity). To enforce hard-blocking pin use /pin-hard.

raj: if we do /pin-hard we risk throttling canary capacity. prefer soft-pin + shim patch to tokenizer in canary image. Dmitri, can you produce a canary image with shim?

dmitri: yes — I can build a shim that pre-normalizes inputs. will push a canary image tag by EOD. Will run local reproducer against long-docs-suite.

maria: timeline: pin extended to 3h (manual extension), Dmitri pushes shim image, QA runs long-docs-suite, if pass we lift pin and deploy shim; if fail we roll back canary to previous model variant and keep runtime pinned. Agreed? :thumbsup:

taylor: I'll add a short entry to the release notes under "Canary mitigations" and update the runtime-compat doc with the observable and the suggested remediation (shim + tokenizer-bisect).

deploybot: pin extension executed: runtime=2.14.1 scope=eu-west new_expires_at=3851239967 by=maria status=success

qa-bot: queued: long-docs-suite run against shim-image tag=azul-quant-shim-385 by=dmitri; ETA ~45m.

raj: fallback/rollback plan reminders: 1) if shim fails, rollback model canary to azul-quant-v1 (existing stable) using deploybot command; 2) if rollback fails or causes downstream errors, escalate to incident channel and run rollback playbook (runbook ID RLB-3). Make sure incidents team on standby.

maria: agree. also adding a note: owners should include the canary dataset ids we saw in the ticket. filing internal ticket IR-3892 with artifacts.

dmitri: pushed shim image and logs attached to IR-3892. running tests now.

qa-bot: long-docs-suite finished -> 0/120 failed against shim-image tag=azul-quant-shim-385. confidence=high.

raj: great — plan to lift pin in 30m after we monitor a short warmup. Who will run the lift command?

maria: I'll lift the pin once we hit 10k tokens processed without regression. tagging @taylor to post a short change notice to #general after lift.

deploybot: INFO: upcoming command examples:
```
# soft pin
/deploybot pin runtime=2.14.1 scope=eu-west duration=3h
# hard pin (avoid unless necessary)
/deploybot pin-hard runtime=2.14.1 scope=eu-west
# rollback model canary
/deploybot rollback model=azul-quant-v2 target=azul-quant-v1 scope=eu-west
```

maria: thanks team. leaving the pin in place for now. will post final closure in ~1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
